visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair in a gray sweater sits at a Japanese restaurant table filled with skewers and sashimi. She is sprinkling seasoning on her food. (2) She looks at the camera, touches her cheek, and makes a cute expression. A man's hand enters from the left pointing at her. (3) She flips her hair back, showing off its glossiness. The scene transitions to a white logo on a gray wall. (4) A close-up shows her long, healthy dark hair from behind. (5) A staff member wearing a black and white uniform uses a handheld scalp detection device on the woman's head. (6) A tablet screen displays a microscopic view of hair follicles and scalp health. (7) The woman lies in a salon chair having her hair washed and treated with a silver steaming cap. (8) A therapist performs a facial massage and cleansing on the woman using various professional skincare products and devices. (9) The woman undergoes a facial treatment with a high-frequency tool and a steam machine. (10) A Shiba Inu dog plays with a yellow ball in the salon's waiting area. (11) A golden facial mask is applied to the woman's face with a brush. (12) She lies under a large white light-therapy dome emitting purple/blue light. (13) The woman stands against a light wall, looking at the camera with vibrant, glowing skin, cheering with her hands up. (14) Final promotional graphic appears with pink background and text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A casual conversation begins with a male voice questioning a female voice over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop track. (2) A bubble pop sound effect emphasizes the woman's playful response. (3) A whoosh transition leads into a structured narrative. (4) A second female voice provides a professional, informative narration over the music, detailing the hair and skin treatments. (5) Each new treatment step is punctuated by quick cuts in the audio bed. (6) A short percussive thud is heard as a dog catches a ball. (7) The main female voice returns with high arousal and positivity, shouting 'YA' to celebrate the results, followed by a final musical swell.
